sources.ref: STMicroelectronics VL53L1X (local copy in the asset workspace)

copy.summary: Laser time-of-flight, 3 cm to 4 m, over I2C
copy.wiringNote: Power VIN from 3.3 V. One sensor answers on 0x29; leave XSHUT and GPIO unconnected. To share the bus, wire each XSHUT pin and pick an address from 0x30 to 0x33. It runs in long distance mode, which reaches about 4 m. The build needs the Pololu VL53L1X library, which Studio installs the first time.
